scenes.text: This is what hyaluronic acid actually does to dry skin.
scenes.head:
What hyaluronic acid
does to dry skin

scenes.text: When your skin is dehydrated, the top layer runs low on water. It feels tight and looks dull.
scenes.head:
Step 1
The surface dries out

scenes.text: Hyaluronic acid is a humectant. It pulls water into that top layer and holds it there.
scenes.head:
Step 2
It pulls water in

scenes.text: Your skin looks plumper and smoother. Seal it in with a moisturiser.
scenes.head:
Step 3
Skin looks plumper

scenes.text: Tip: apply it on damp skin. Next episode: ceramides.

caption:
What hyaluronic acid actually does to dry skin 💧
It's a humectant: it pulls water into the top layer of your skin and holds it there, so skin looks plumper. Apply on damp skin, then seal with a moisturiser.
On the label: sodium hyaluronate, hyaluronic acid.
Save this for your next routine. Ingredient Explained, ep. 03.
